131:     def __init__(
132:         self,
133:         input_size: int,
134:         output_size: int,
135:         hidden_size: int = 1024,
136:         num_layers: int = 2,
137:         min_std: float = 1e-4,
138:         num_modes: int = 5,
139:         low_eval_noise: bool = False,
140:         loss_coef: float = 1.0,
141:     ):
142:         super().__init__()
143:         self.num_modes = num_modes
144:         self.output_size = output_size
145:         self.min_std = min_std
146:         self.low_eval_noise = low_eval_noise      
147:         self.loss_coef = loss_coef                
148: 
149:         # Shared MLP
150:         if num_layers > 0:
151:             layers = [nn.Linear(input_size, hidden_size), nn.ReLU()]
152:             for _ in range(num_layers - 1):
153:                 layers += [nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size), nn.ReLU()]
154:             self.shared_net = nn.Sequential(*layers)
155:         else:
156:             self.shared_net = nn.Identity()
157: 
158:         # Output layers
159:         self.mean_layer = nn.Linear(hidden_size, output_size * num_modes)
160:         self.logstd_layer = nn.Linear(hidden_size, output_size * num_modes)
161:         self.logits_layer = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_modes)
162: 
163:     def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> tD.MixtureSameFamily:
164:         """
165:         x: (B, T, input_size)
166:         returns: GMM distribution of shape (B, T)
167:         """
168:         if x.dim() == 2:
169:             x = x.unsqueeze(1)
170:         B, T, D = x.shape
171:         x_flat = x.view(B * T, D)
172:         hidden = self.shared_net(x_flat)  # (B*T, hidden_size)
173: 
174:         # Means
175:         means = self.mean_layer(hidden)  # (B*T, num_modes * output_size)
176:         means = means.view(B, T, self.num_modes, self.output_size)
177: 
178:         # Log-stds -> positive std
179:         logstds = self.logstd_layer(hidden)
180:         logstds = logstds.view(B, T, self.num_modes, self.output_size)
181:         stds = F.softplus(logstds) + self.min_std
182: 
183:         # Mixing logits
184:         logits = self.logits_layer(hidden).view(B, T, self.num_modes)
185: 
186:         # Low noise eval: replace std with min_std
187:         if not self.training and self.low_eval_noise:
188:             stds = torch.full_like(stds, fill_value=self.min_std)
189: 
190:         # Build distributions
191:         component_dist = tD.Independent(
192:             tD.Normal(loc=means, scale=stds), 1
193:         )  # treats last dim as event dim
194:         mixture_dist = tD.Categorical(logits=logits)
195:         gmm = tD.MixtureSameFamily(mixture_dist, component_dist)
196:         return gmm
